payload.rationale: Training-objective tweak for autoregressive image-token generation (multi-token prediction, contrastive regularization); no bridge to B-rep encoding, pointer decoding, or program/mesh generation.
Survey of LLM hallucination in cybersecurity vulnerability triage; unrelated application, no transferable mechanism.
E-commerce demand forecasting with action-conditioned transformers; no bridge to CAD/program generation.

Compares autoregressive coordinate-sequence decoding vs. detection/heatmap assembly for recovering structured vector geometry (walls/graphs) from raster input, plus domain-shift findings on which readout generalizes better -- directly relevant to our structural-validity/readout and domain-gap concerns for a graph-conditioned geometry decoder.

Review of collapse in on-policy self-distillation (privileged-teacher imitation) for math reasoning; conceptually adjacent to our verifier-in-the-loop / rejection-sampled SFT training but confined to LLM reasoning, no geometry or program-synthesis mechanism.

Diffusion transformer that generates structured vertex-edge graphs (roof topology) conditioned on footprint/image, with an edge-prediction module for topology -- a close methodological bridge to generating structured CAD/mesh-program graphs from geometric input.

LLM-agent kernel-optimization framework using an experience graph populated with execution/correctness feedback to guide future decisions; relevant by analogy to verifier-in-the-loop / execution-feedback training but the domain (hardware kernels) and mechanism (retrieval memory) don't transfer directly to program/mesh generation.
Emergent multi-agent society building physical artifacts via stigmergy; unrelated to structured program/geometry generation.
NLP argument-summarization structured-prediction benchmark; no bridge to geometry or program synthesis.
SQL-based metapath pruning to speed up GNN training on relational databases; touches GNNs but no bridge to B-rep encoding, pointer/copy mechanisms, or program generation.
Biomechanics-grounded action-quality assessment for fitness coaching; unrelated application.

Masked-diffusion draft-conditioned correction of flawed LLM reasoning traces; loosely analogous to repair/edit distillation of broken rollouts (our item 1) but scoped to math/code reasoning with no geometry or program-execution verifier.

Test-time self-verification for diffusion language models via prefix-conditioned regeneration stability; a verification-style idea but specific to DLM reasoning benchmarks, weak transfer to our verifier-guided program generation.
Streaming temporal modeling for vision-language-action robot policies; unrelated application.
Multi-label test-time adaptation for vision-language classifiers; unrelated application.

RL framework that treats point coordinates as an executable interface with a deterministic verifier scoring pointing predictions (coverage, cardinality, validity) -- a partial bridge to pointer/copy addressing and verifier-guided training, but the domain is GUI/robotic visual grounding, not B-rep/program generation.

Neural operator with a spectral-radius-constrained propagator to stabilize autoregressive PDE rollout; interesting stability mechanism for autoregressive generation, but domain (continuum PDE simulation) and representation are far from graph-conditioned program decoding.
Speculative decoding for agentic LLM inference efficiency under context compression; no bridge to structural validity, B-rep encoding, or program synthesis.

Diagnoses why alternating LLM-teacher/GNN co-training fails to improve node classification; touches GNN encoder representation learning but no transferable mechanism for B-rep encoders or program decoding.
Trains VLMs to reason in natural language to steer low-level robot manipulation policies via RL; unrelated application, no structured-program or geometry mechanism.
Benchmark and reward model for video generation aesthetics; unrelated application.

Trains a compact planner to emit structured edits (typed timeline patches) checked by a deterministic verifier against an explicit constraint ledger, using verifier-replayed multi-teacher distillation and a self-improvement stage where the student scores its own repairs -- closely mirrors our verifier-guided structural-validity and self-play/rejection-sampling training loop for program generation.
Pose-anchored optical flow for early human action recognition in HRI; unrelated application.

Program synthesizer that keeps LLM proposals as syntax trees and scores grammar-rule expansions in context during enumerative search, guaranteeing every rule stays reachable so grammar constraints are respected while LLM guidance steers the search -- directly on-target for structural validity of generated programs and constrained/guided program synthesis.

Listwise (Plackett-Luce) VLM-preference reward learning for RL manipulation policies; reward-model methodology tangential to self-play/verifier training but domain and mechanism (visual preference ranking) don't transfer to our program-generation verifier.
Watermarking scheme for spiking neural network checkpoints; unrelated to program/geometry generation.
Privacy-attack risk assessment for LLM-enhanced GNN node/link/membership inference; unrelated to our structural-generation problem.

Theoretical extension of graph fibration symmetry theory applied to neural network compression; the underlying graph-symmetry formalism is conceptually related to symmetry/orbit ambiguity when pointing at congruent B-rep nodes, but the paper is abstract theory with no direct program/geometry-generation application shown.
Rubric-based RL reward decomposition for visual faithfulness in VLM QA; unrelated application, no structural-generation mechanism.
Frequency-aware wavelet forecasting for typhoon wind gusts; unrelated application.
Measures cross-lingual skill inconsistency in LLMs via multilingual self-play games; unrelated to geometry/program generation.

Studies grammar-constrained decoding (beam search vs. sample+vote) for text-to-SQL under a strict output grammar across model sizes -- directly relevant methodological bridge to constrained/structured decoding strategies for our grammar-constrained program decoder, including the finding that constrained trade-offs behave differently than unconstrained ones.
Benchmark/testbed for pose and camera-intrinsics sensitivity in NeRF/3DGS novel-view synthesis; different geometric domain (radiance fields, not B-rep/CAD), no transferable mechanism.
Position paper speculating on vision-centered pathways to AGI; no concrete transferable mechanism for our problem.

Casts theorem-prover tableau construction as a policy in a sound transition system, trained by imitation learning from found proofs with a GNN scoring proof edits, and studies performance as symbolic search scaffolding is removed -- a strong methodological bridge to structured program/proof synthesis via GNN-guided search and imitation learning, close to our structural-validity and search-guided decoding concerns.

Empirical study of inference-time sampling strategies (classifier-free guidance, reward-guided beam search) for multimodal protein language models generating sequence-structure pairs; reward-guided beam search over a structured generative model is a relevant mechanism, but the domain (protein generation) and lack of an execution/compilation verifier limit the bridge to our problem.
